summary: MasTec, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a proposed offering of senior unsecured notes due 20--. The notes rank equally with existing and future senior unsecured debt, are structurally subordinated to subsidiary obligations, and are redeemable at the issuer's option. They include a change-of-control put at 101% of principal. Joint book-runners are PNC, Truist, Wells Fargo, BofA, and J.P. Morgan. The offering is a routine debt capital raise, not a special-situation event; no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic action is involved.
